1463.takeaway: Move both robots together row by row: the state is just the pair of columns, and processing rows bottom-up lets each cell take the best of nine follow-up states.

2029.takeaway: Only stone values modulo 3 matter, so count the three kinds and decide the winner from the parity of the zeros and the balance between ones and twos.
